simple.summary: נָכֵא (nâkêʼ) means smitten , i.e. (figuratively) afflicted First listed occurrence: Isa 16 7.

definitions.full: H5218. nake ' [ נָכָא ] adjective stricken ; — masculine plural נְכָאִים Isa 16:7 (Kö ii. 1, 73 ), of Moab prostrated by conquest. [ נָכֵא ] adjective id., always feminine נְכֵאָה רוּחַ a stricken spirit , Prov 15:13 ; 17:22 (both opposed to שָׁמֵךְַ לֵב ), 18:14 .
